definitions.explanation: exercising the right to remain silent, especially in legal contexts

examples.japanese: {容疑者|ようぎしゃ}は{黙秘|もくひ}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: The suspect continues to remain silent.

examples.japanese: {黙秘|もくひ}{権|けん}を{行使|こうし}します。
examples.english: I will exercise my right to remain silent.

examples.japanese: {弁護士|べんごし}に{相談|そうだん}するまで{黙秘|もくひ}することにした。
examples.english: I decided to remain silent until I consult with a lawyer.

notes:
FORMATION:
{黙|もく} (silence) + {秘|ひ} (secret) → keeping silent

VERB FORM:
{黙秘|もくひ}する (to remain silent, to refuse to answer)

LEGAL TERM:
{黙秘|もくひ}{権|けん} (right to remain silent) - A constitutional right in Japan protecting individuals from self-incrimination.

COLLOCATIONS:
- {黙秘|もくひ}を{貫|つらぬ}く (to maintain silence)
- {黙秘|もくひ}を{破|やぶ}る (to break silence)
- {完全|かんぜん}{黙秘|もくひ} (complete silence)

RELATED WORDS:
- {供述|きょうじゅつ} (statement, testimony)
- {自白|じはく} (confession)
